claims.claim: Under the recorded definition, an AVL search tree is a Weak Search Tree supporting every insertion and deletion, including rebalancing, in deterministic O(log(n+2)) worst-case time.
claims.evidence: For every AVL node v, the strict BST invariant implies l<key(v)<r for every key l in v's left subtree and r in v's right subtree, hence l<r, exactly satisfying Definition 1's WST invariant. Ordinary AVL insertion and deletion preserve strict BST order. Bottom-up rebalancing performs at most one single or double rotation at each affected ancestor, with constant work per ancestor; rotations preserve inorder order and restore the AVL height inequalities. If M(h) is the minimum size at height h, M(h)=1+M(h-1)+M(h-2) implies M(h)>=2^floor(h/2), so h=O(log(n+2)). Thus updates, including all rebalancing, have deterministic worst-case O(log(n+2)) time. This verifies the bounded subclass claim, independently of whether it answers the target's intended WST problem.
claims.search_method: Direct proof from the authorized Definition 1, symbolic audit of AVL rotations and the minimum-size recurrence, and adversarial comparison of the claim's quantifiers with the exact target and source model; no external search.

target_evidence: The verified claim concerns only the strict-BST subclass of WSTs. The source expressly already observes that every BST is a WST, while framing the open problem around trees governed only by the weak invariant: their node keys cannot generally act as split routers, and ordinary rotations can destroy their invariant. The draft instead initializes a strict AVL/BST, searches using the stronger ordering, and relies on rotations whose correctness follows from that stronger ordering. It provides no update/rebalancing method for weak-only, non-BST WST states and no matching obstruction in the source model. Treating the subclass observation as resolving the problem would make the quoted open question vacuous despite the source already knowing the subclass inclusion. Accordingly, the final writeup's assertion that it resolves the target and its claimed FULL resolution are not established: target coverage is OVERCLAIMED and claimed_resolution is OVERSTATED.
checks_performed: Read only the designated source-input JSON and draft JSON; used no web or other solution material.
Compared the sole claim against Definition 1 and proved that the strict BST invariant implies the WST invariant.
Audited standard AVL insertion, deletion, rotation preservation, per-ancestor work, and the minimum-node height recurrence symbolically.
Compared the construction's maintained state space and routing assumptions with the exact target, source-open statement, and source-model discussion.
No finite or computational claim required an exact-arithmetic checker, so no checker file was applicable and no repository file was modified.
